Carries the paired branch for phase 7 of the default-workspace-template's chat-agent split (`mngr/chat-agent-refactor-8`) into this branch: the bridge creates the driver's chat through `POST /api/chats/create` and addresses the sends, the event reads, and the model choice at `/api/chats/<chat_id>/...`.

The driver test for a message that went out but drew no reply no longer relies on a 0.3 s trial budget expiring in time: the mock workspace's events poll stops answering once that message has gone out (`ConversationModel.events_poll_failing_after_message`), so the driver's give-up after consecutive bridge failures ends the wait and the test's outcome does not depend on how quickly the machine got through the opening exchange (it timed out early on a slow CI runner, reading one message sent instead of two).
